routine.title: Speed + COD + Aerobic — Full
routine.notes: Full conditioning day. Use when there is no extra hard football load. Quality first: sprint reps need full recovery. If a double football session appears, use the Quick version instead. If pain changes stride or rises, stop/regress.

exercises.notes: 6 x 15-20 m. Build progressively; fast and relaxed, not fatigued. Walk back then recover fully.
Accelerate 10-15 m then brake under control inside a planned zone. 3 reps each side/lead pattern. Chest controlled, hips back, no collapsing knee.
Planned 45-90 degree cuts. 3 each side. Prioritise clean plant, body position and re-acceleration. Reactive COD belongs in football sessions.
Easy-moderate aerobic work. Conversational effort / roughly 60-70%. Do not turn this into another hard interval session.
